description: This file defines a React functional component 'LoginForm' that renders a login form with username/email and password fields, including client-side validation, error handling, and exposing a public 'onLogin' interface for parent components.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form fields, ensuring both username/email and password are filled, and sets error messages accordingly.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles the form submission, performs validation, and calls the 'onLogin' callback with credentials if valid.
